item.description: For those who prefer to read the code instead of text, source code is available on GitHub . (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: DeepSeek-v4-flash-vision-exp
item.description: The deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp model accepts images alongside text, so you can ask the model to describe pictures, read text from screenshots, analyze charts, and more. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: AI companies destroy physical books – let's scan rare books before it's too late
item.description: AI companies are secretly buying, scanning, and destroying millions of physical books to train their models, permanently locking human knowledge inside private corporate servers. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Cloudflare Turns Engineering Standards Into an AI-Enforced Control System
item.description: Cloudflare has recently detailed how it is using AI to transform internal engineering standards from passive documentation into an actively enforced control system across the software development lifecycle. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Enchant Your AI and APIs with eBPF Magic 🪄
item.description: Dan Finneran discusses the risks of unowned AI-generated code in production and demonstrates how eBPF can intercept and control AI API traffic in Kubernetes. (1 source: infoq)
